newsitem.title: USA: Compaq shares may be overvalued - Barron's.
newsitem.headline: Compaq shares may be overvalued - Barron's.

text.p: Shares of Compaq Computer Corp may be overvalued because of slowing demand among computer retailers and resellers, Barron's said in its "Up and Down Wall Street" column.
That slowing demand may hit Compaq and other computer makers, the magazine said.

The magazine said that about 20 percent of Compaq's domestic revenue, for example, comes from computer reseller CompuCom Systems Inc, which said Friday it anticipates softness in sales growth for the first quarter, resulting in lower-than-expected earnings.

"The only clear inference, then," Barron's said of the CompuCom news, "is that Compaq has got to be hurting some, too." The magazine added that Compaq's shares are "still selling at a price that doesn't square with what's happening in the PC business."
